sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Check current state after purple expansion
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']

# Count pixels by color
color_pixels = {}
for n in nodes:
    c = n['color']
    color_pixels[c] = color_pixels.get(c, 0) + n['pixels']
print("Pixels by color:", {k: v for k, v in sorted(color_pixels.items())})

# Check agent position
agent = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'b']
if agent:
    rows = [p[0] for p in agent[0]['boundary']]
    cols = [p[1] for p in agent[0]['boundary']]
    print(f"Agent: row {min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, col {min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

# Check purple region
purple = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'p']
if purple:
    total_purple = sum(n['pixels'] for n in purple)
    rows = [p[0] for n in purple for p in n['boundary']]
    cols = [p[1] for n in purple for p in n['boundary']]
    print(f"Purple: {total_purple} pixels, row {min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, col {min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

# Check black region
black = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'B']
if black:
    total_black = sum(n['pixels'] for n in black)
    print(f"Black: {total_black} pixels, {len(black)} objects")

# Check sky blue region
sky = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'S']
if sky:
    total_sky = sum(n['pixels'] for n in sky)
    print(f"Sky blue: {total_sky} pixels")

# Try moving RIGHT to see if purple expands differently
print("\n--- Testing RIGHT moves ---")
for i in range(5):
    result = action(['RIGHT'])
    if result.get('game_over'):
        print(f"Game over after RIGHT {i+1}")
        break
    
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    nodes = seg['nodes']
    color_pixels = {}
    for n in nodes:
        c = n['color']
        color_pixels[c] = color_pixels.get(c, 0) + n['pixels']
    print(f"RIGHT {i+1}: W={color_pixels.get('W',0)}, p={color_pixels.get('p',0)}, B={color_pixels.get('B',0)}, S={color_pixels.get('S',0)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
